Method of Attack: Scanning the Internet or using services such as Shodan.io to find unprotected MongoDB servers, connecting to the database, deleting it, and leaving a ransom note demanding payment for decryption
Automated script that accesses MongoDB databases, possibly exports data, deletes the database, and creates a ransom note
Attack Vector: Remotely accessible and unprotected MongoDB database instances
Indicators of Compromise: New database named 'Warning' with a collection named 'Readme' containing ransom note
Ransom note email addresses: mongodb@8chan.co, dbbackups@protonmail.com
Ransom note text demanding 0.1 BTC and instructing not to delete 'Unique_KEY'
